heroSummary: Dysart’s 2026–27 school year begins Thursday, August 6, 2026, and ends Thursday, May 27, 2027. Fall Break is October 12–16, Thanksgiving Recess is November 23–27, Winter Break is December 21–January 4, and Spring Break is March 15–19. Monday early dismissal begins August 10 and applies on Mondays when school is in session. K–8 conference days and high school final-exam days follow separate early-release schedules.
calendarNotes: The official Dysart 2026–27 school calendar lists 180 student days. K–8 quarter counts are 46, 39, 47, and 48 days; high school semesters are 85 and 95 days. Early release does not work the same way for every grade level: Mondays when school is in session, K–8 conference days, high school final-exam days, and semester-end dates use separate schedules.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Dysart start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Dysart starts the 2026–27 school year on Thursday, August 6, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Monday early dismissal begin in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Monday early dismissal begins August 10, 2026, and applies on Mondays when school is in session.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Dysart K–8 conference dates are half days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: October 8–9, 2026, and February 4–5, 2027, are half days for K–8 students.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the calendar download include every Monday early dismissal?
calendarFaqs.a: No. It includes the districtwide dates listed on this page but not a separate event for each Monday early dismissal.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later Dysart revisions.

customSections.label: Schedule Changes Families Should Know About
customSections.content: Early release does not work the same way for every grade level. Students are dismissed early on Mondays when school is in session for teacher professional development. K–8 students also have early release for conferences on October 8–9 and February 4–5. High school students are released early for final exams on December 17–18 and May 26–27. On May 27, K–8 students are also released early for the last day of school.

customSections.content: Dysart still lists 180 student days in 2026–27, but several planning dates shift from the previous school year.

rows: School starts on August 6, compared with July 31 in 2025–26.
Back-to-school plans shift nearly a week later.
Fall Break moves to October 12–16, compared with October 13–17 in 2025–26.
The five-day break shifts one day earlier.
Winter Break ends January 4, compared with January 5 in 2025–26.
Students return on January 5 instead of January 6.
Spring Break moves to March 15–19, compared with March 16–20 in 2025–26.
Spring Break also begins and ends one day earlier.
High school semesters change from an even 90/90 split to 85 days in the first semester and 95 in the second.
The second semester is 10 instructional days longer than the first.
